observations: notes_left L1-L5: the end of note 10 of p. 170, on Sarbozah.

notes_left L13-L24: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXIII) add to note 3: J. Canal, Tiaret, monographie ancienne et moderne (Bulletin trimestral de géographie et d'archéologie d'Oran, t. XX, 1900, p. 1-44).
notes_right L19: the Syriac word is printed in Estrangela.

notes_right L10-L13: Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XXIII, note 2) take back «infrequens»: the name of the Sea of the Varangians, which an-Naysābūrī also has (printed ورتك in the Cairo edition), is not so rare as this note says after Abū ’l-fidā’; see al-Qazwīnī, ed. Wüstenfeld, t. II, p. 416, ad-Dimashqī, pp. 19, 21, 182 and 193, and above all C. M. Frähn, Ibn Foszlan's und anderer Araber Berichte über die Russen älterer Zeit (St. Petersburg 1823), pp. 177-204, who gathered the Arabic and Persian witnesses of this sea to the 17th century.
body L5: the last t of «Tāhart» is printed broken, like l.
